vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the cooling-off period above; waiting 5 days on a known CVE is the wrong trade.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate only bumps direct dependencies, so refresh the whole lockfile weekly to pick up transitive fixes.

packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates straight to the branch when CI is green. Renovate only opens a PR when the update fails, so a passing bump makes no noise.

Stay on TypeScript 6: ts-jest 29 does not expose the compiler API TS 7 needs, and typescript-eslint refuses to load against TS 7.0 (see typescript-eslint issue 10940, which targets TS 7.1). Drop this rule once both support TS 7.
Keep @types/node on the major that matches the runtime. Renovate manages the Dockerfile tag; .nvmrc and the CI matrix are updated by hand, so bump all four together.
